scenicChapters.title: Corsica West Coast D81
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Corsica West Coast D81, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

corsica-west-coast-d81.story: A one-way ride of 173 km, Ajaccio to Calvi - roughly 2 h 20 in the saddle. On the way it passes Cargese, Calanques de Piana, Porto and Col de la Croix. The highest point is about 850 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
